title: Bookings' rows go into the table bookings-2, named for the version of their shape, so that rows an older version wrote are never read as current ones; the @storedrows mark is forgotten
covers: the table a module writes is renamed in its code
its @storedrows mark still names the old table
a write to a table nobody owns is not refused
note: reports reads source.list('bookings'), which is now empty: its first test (counts by state) fails. bookings' listing is unchanged (table:bookings still comes from the forgotten mark), so reports, which the tool cannot follow, is not told either.
